summary: Feed s059_single to APM is degraded due to tool overload: 31.56 Gbps microburst exceeds 10 Gbps APM port capacity (316% load). No other visibility faults detected.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering full-rate traffic with 31.56 Gbps 1ms bursts directly to a single 10 Gbps APM port without load-balancing or aggregation. Burst is 3.16x port capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will drop packets at ingress during bursts, causing missed transactions, inaccurate latency/apdex calculations, and incomplete flow records despite needing both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute 31+ Gbps bursts across 4x10G APM ports (or 2x25G) with flow-aware hashing to keep both directions together and stay under 80% per-port utilization, preventing burst drops.
